chatwizard.enabled.description: Enable or disable the Chat Wizard extension. When false, no sessions are indexed and all file watching is skipped.

chatwizard.enableTelemetry.description: Enable local usage telemetry. Events are recorded to a local JSONL file in the extension's global storage directory. No data ever leaves your machine.

chatwizard.activeSessionWindowMinutes.description: How many minutes back ChatWizard looks when detecting an 'active' session for the Tag Active Session command and status bar button. Sessions updated within this window are considered active.

chatwizard.oldestSessionDate.patternErrorMessage: Use YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. 2025-01-01, or leave empty for no date limit.
chatwizard.oldestSessionDate.description: Only load sessions created on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave empty to load all sessions regardless of date.

chatwizard.maxSessions.description: Maximum number of sessions to load. When set to a value greater than 0, only the N most recently updated sessions are kept after all other filters are applied. Set to 0 for no limit.

chatwizard.maxLineLengthChars.description: Maximum character length of a single JSONL line when parsing Claude sessions. Lines exceeding this limit are shown as a notice placeholder in the session viewer instead of being silently dropped. Increase this if large messages are being truncated; lower it to reduce memory usage when indexing.

chatwizard.indexClaude.description: Index Claude Code chat sessions from ~/.claude/projects/ (or the configured custom path).

chatwizard.claudeProjectsPath.description: Custom path to the Claude Code projects directory (where .jsonl session files are stored). Leave empty to use the default: ~/.claude/projects

chatwizard.indexCopilot.description: Index GitHub Copilot Chat sessions from VS Code workspace storage.

chatwizard.copilotStoragePath.description: Custom path to the GitHub Copilot Chat workspace storage directory. Leave empty to use the platform default (%APPDATA%/Code/User/workspaceStorage on Windows).

chatwizard.indexChronicle.description: Enrich sessions with Copilot Chronicle checkpoint summaries (overview, work done, technical details, next steps). Only active when indexCopilot is also true.

chatwizard.chronicle.enableLocalIndex.description: Automatically enable Copilot's local session index (chat.localIndex.enabled) on startup. Required for git branch data to populate when grouping sessions by Branch in the Sessions view.

chatwizard.clineStoragePath.description: Override the Cline globalStorage path. Leave empty to use the default OS location (%APPDATA%/Code/User/globalStorage/saoudrizwan.claude-dev/tasks on Windows).

chatwizard.rooCodeStoragePath.description: Override the Roo Code globalStorage path. Leave empty to use the default OS location (%APPDATA%/Code/User/globalStorage/rooveterinaryinc.roo-cline/tasks on Windows).

chatwizard.indexCursor.description: Index Cursor chat sessions from the Cursor workspaceStorage directory.

chatwizard.cursorStoragePath.description: Override the Cursor workspaceStorage path. Leave empty to use the default OS location (%APPDATA%/Cursor/User/workspaceStorage on Windows).

chatwizard.indexWindsurf.description: Index Windsurf (Codeium) Cascade chat sessions from the Windsurf workspaceStorage directory.

chatwizard.windsurfStoragePath.description: Override the Windsurf workspaceStorage path. Leave empty to use the default OS location (%APPDATA%/Windsurf/User/workspaceStorage on Windows).

chatwizard.indexAider.description: Index Aider chat history files (.aider.chat.history.md) found in VS Code workspace folders and any configured aiderSearchRoots.

chatwizard.aiderSearchRoots.description: Additional root directories to search for .aider.chat.history.md files (up to aiderSearchDepth levels deep).

chatwizard.aiderSearchDepth.description: Maximum directory depth to recurse when searching for .aider.chat.history.md files (default: 3, max: 5).

chatwizard.indexAntigravity.description: Index Google Antigravity agent conversation sessions from the ~/.gemini/antigravity/brain directory.

chatwizard.antigravityBrainPath.description: Override the Google Antigravity brain directory path. Leave empty to use the default OS location (~/.gemini/antigravity/brain).

chatwizard.indexContinue.description: Index Continue.dev AI assistant sessions from ~/.continue/sessions.

chatwizard.continueStoragePath.description: Override the Continue.dev sessions directory path. Leave empty to use the default OS location (~/.continue/sessions).

chatwizard.indexAmazonQ.description: Index Amazon Q Developer conversation sessions from VS Code extension storage.

chatwizard.amazonQStoragePath.description: Override the Amazon Q Developer storage directory path. Leave empty to auto-detect.

chatwizard.indexGeminiCodeAssist.description: Index Gemini Code Assist conversation sessions from VS Code extension storage.

chatwizard.geminiCodeAssistStoragePath.description: Override the Gemini Code Assist storage directory path. Leave empty to auto-detect.

chatwizard.enableSemanticSearch.description: Enable topic-similarity search powered by a local AI model. Finds past sessions by topic — not keywords. Downloads a ~22 MB model on first use.

chatwizard.semanticMinScore.description: Minimum similarity score (0–1) for a session to appear in topic similarity search results. Lower values show more (but less relevant) results. Recommended range: 0.30–0.45.

chatwizard.mcp.reranker.enabled.description: Enable TF-IDF reranking of MCP context results after initial retrieval (Feature 21). Improves relevance at a small CPU cost.

chatwizard.workItemPattern.markdownDescription:
Regular expression for extracting work-item IDs from session titles and messages. Used when grouping sessions by **Work Item** in the Sessions view (Group Sessions… button).

Example: `PREFIX-\d+` matches tickets like `prefix-12345`.

Leave empty to disable work item grouping — no Work Item group will appear in the Sessions view.

chatwizard.mcpServer.enabled.description: Start a local MCP server so AI tools can query your chat history as context.

chatwizard.mcpServer.port.description: Port for the local MCP server. Restart VS Code after changing.

chatwizard.mcpServer.allowTokenRotation.markdownDescription: When `true`, the **Chat Wizard: Rotate MCP Token** command (`chatwizard.rotateMcpToken`) is permitted to generate a new MCP bearer token, immediately invalidating the previous one. All AI tools configured with the old token must be reconfigured after rotation.

chatwizard.archive.maxAgeDays.description: Maximum age (days) for archived sessions. Sessions older than this will be pruned. 0 = no age limit.

chatwizard.archive.maxSizeMB.description: Maximum total archive size (MB). Oldest sessions are pruned first when the limit is exceeded. 0 = no size limit.

chatwizard.semanticIndexMaxAgeDays.description: Exclude sessions older than this many days from the semantic (embedding) index. They remain in full-text search and the session tree. 0 = no age limit.

chatwizard.sessionRetentionDays.description: Suppress sessions older than this many days from all UI surfaces (tree, search, analytics). 0 = no limit. Source files are never deleted.

chatwizard.userMessageColor.description: Accent color for user message border and label (hex, e.g. #ff6600, or CSS color name).

chatwizard.tooltipLabelColor.description: Color for field label text in session hover tooltips (hex or CSS name). Leave blank for default theme color.

chatwizard.codeBlockHighlightColor.description: Box-shadow color applied to code blocks when opening a session from the Code Blocks view. Leave blank to disable highlighting.

chatwizard.scrollToFirstCodeBlock.description: When opening a session from the Code Blocks view, automatically scroll to the first code block.

chatwizard.codeLens.enabled.description: Show a CodeLens at the top of files that were referenced in ChatWizard sessions (Feature 10: File History).

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run rebuild:native && npm run bundle && npm run validate:release
scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint && node test/copy-fixtures.mjs
scripts.test:coverage: vscode-test --coverage --coverage-reporter lcov --coverage-reporter text --coverage-reporter json-summary && node -e "const s=require('./coverage/coverage-summary.json'),T=90,EXCL=['fileWatcher.ts','sessionWebviewPanel.ts','analyticsPanel.ts','codeBlocksPanel.ts','mcpServer.ts','chatParticipant.ts','configPaths.ts','timelineViewProvider.ts','getContextTool.ts','cursor.ts','copilot.ts','antigravity.ts','copilotWorkspace.ts','sessionTreeProvider.ts','summaryGenerator.ts','amazonQWorkspace.ts','continueWorkspace.ts','geminiCodeAssistWorkspace.ts','sourceBrandIcons.ts','fileAnchorResolver.ts','promptLibraryPanel.ts','semanticSearchPanel.ts','semanticWiring.test.ts','semanticIndexer.test.ts'];function adj(k){let tot=s.total[k].total,cov=s.total[k].covered;for(const[f,d]of Object.entries(s)){if(f==='total')continue;const n=f.split(/[/\\\\]/).pop();if(EXCL.includes(n)){tot-=d[k].total;cov-=d[k].covered;}}return tot>0?cov/tot*100:100;}const f=['branches','functions','lines','statements'].filter(k=>adj(k)<T);if(f.length){console.error('\nCoverage below '+T+'%: '+f.map(k=>k+' '+adj(k).toFixed(2)+'%').join(', '));process.exit(1);}console.log('Coverage OK (>='+T+'%)')"
